title: A constrained subtype receives a value outside its range
description: Ada subtypes carry runtime constraints. When a range check detects that a value falls outside the declared bounds, the runtime raises Constraint_Error instead of silently storing an invalid value.
fingerprint: a constrained subtype receives a value outside its range

provenance.source_title: A constrained subtype receives a value outside its range

title: A hole leaves an unsolved metavariable
description: Agda turns an omitted term into a metavariable and checks whether unification can determine it. A polymorphic function with no input evidence leaves that metavariable unsolved, so the module is rejected.
bad_example:
postulate A : Set
bad : A
bad = ?
good_example:
postulate A : Set
good : A -> A
good x = x
fingerprint: a hole leaves an unsolved metavariable

provenance.source_title: A hole leaves an unsolved metavariable

title: A loop start has no closing bracket
description: Brainfuck loops are paired by matching [ and ]. An interpreter or compiler cannot determine the jump target for an unmatched opening bracket, so it must reject the program before execution.
fingerprint: a loop start has no closing bracket

provenance.source_title: A loop start has no closing bracket

title: A function is called without a visible declaration
description: C compilation needs a visible declaration to type-check a call. Modern C modes reject an undeclared function instead of guessing its return type and calling convention.
bad_example: int main(void) { return total(); }
good_example:
int total(void) { return 42; }
int main(void) { return total(); }
fingerprint: a function is called without a visible declaration

provenance.source_title: A function is called without a visible declaration
